Title: Cart subtotal is correct
Preconditions: Cart has 2 items (10.00 x 2 and 5.50 x 1)
Expected result: Subtotal shows 25.50

Title: Quantity 0 is not allowed
Expected result: Item is removed or an error is shown; total is not negative

Title: Maximum quantity enforced
Expected result: Error shows available stock; quantity is not accepted

Title: Tax rounding at half-cent
Expected result: Tax rounds to 0.08 and total is 1.07

Title: Valid discount code applied
Expected result: Total shows 90.00 and discount line is visible

Title: Expired code rejected
Expected result: Error says code has expired; total unchanged

Title: Code cannot be applied twice
Expected result: Message says already applied; total unchanged

Title: Code is case-insensitive
Expected result: Discount applied

Title: Required shipping fields enforced
Steps: Leave all shipping fields empty and continue
Expected result: Each required field shows an inline error; cannot continue

Title: Invalid postal code rejected
Expected result: Postal code error shown

Title: Name field maximum length
Expected result: Input is limited or error shown; no server error

Title: Approved card places order
Expected result: Order created and confirmation page shown

Title: Declined card keeps cart
Expected result: Decline message shown; cart intact; no order created

Title: Double-click on Place order
Expected result: Exactly one order is created and one charge made

Title: Expired card date rejected
Steps: Enter an expiry date in the past
Expected result: Validation error shown

Title: Confirmation email received
Expected result: Email arrives within 2 minutes with correct order number and total

Title: Order number is unique
Preconditions: Two orders placed in a row
Expected result: Numbers differ

Title: Stock decrements after order
Expected result: Stock shows 3

Title: Last item sold to one buyer only
Steps: Both sessions try to buy the item
Expected result: One order succeeds; the other is told item is out of stock

Title: Out-of-stock item cannot be added
Expected result: Add to cart is disabled and shows "Out of stock"
